title.zh: 安全预警：多名iOS自托管钱包用户报告损失，建议用户更新最新版本
title.en: 安全预警：多名iOS自托管钱包用户报告损失，建议用户更新最新版本

current_state.zh: GoPlus Security warned that multiple iOS self-custody wallet users reported asset losses linked to suspected DarkSword and Coruna iOS exploit tools, urging users to update iOS and check for malicious apps.
